Question: 2
```{r}
bikeshare <- read.csv("bikeshare.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
bikeshare$cnt <- as.numeric(bikeshare$cnt)
bikeshare$weathersit <- factor(
  bikeshare$weathersit,
  levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
  labels = c("Clear", "Mist/Clouds", "Light rain/snow", "Heavy precip")
)
par(mar = c(5, 5, 3, 1))
boxplot(cnt ~ weathersit, data = bikeshare, notch = TRUE,
        ylab = "Bike rentals (cnt)",
        xlab = "Weather situation",
        main = "Bike Rentals by Weather")
```
Question 3,4,5, & 6
```{r}
bikeshare <- read.csv("bikeshare.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
bikeshare$cnt <- as.numeric(bikeshare$cnt)
bikeshare$weathersit <- factor(
  bikeshare$weathersit,
  levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
  labels = c("Clear", "Mist/Clouds", "Light rain/snow", "Heavy precip")
)
bikeshare <- subset(bikeshare, !is.na(cnt) & !is.na(weathersit))
bikeshare$weathersit <- droplevels(bikeshare$weathersit)

print(levels(bikeshare$weathersit))
stopifnot(nlevels(bikeshare$weathersit) >= 2)
if (!"Clear" %in% levels(bikeshare$weathersit)) {
  bikeshare$weathersit <- relevel(bikeshare$weathersit, ref = levels(bikeshare$weathersit)[1])
} else {
  bikeshare$weathersit <- relevel(bikeshare$weathersit, ref = "Clear")
}

fit <- lm(cnt ~ weathersit, data = bikeshare)
summary(fit)

#Question 3
if ("Light rain/snow" %in% names(coef(fit))) {
  beta_wet <- coef(fit)[["Light rain/snow"]]
} else if ("weathersitLight rain/snow" %in% names(coef(fit))) {
  beta_wet <- coef(fit)[["weathersitLight rain/snow"]]
} else {
  beta_wet <- NA_real_  
}

beta_wet                    
beta_wet > 0                  

#Question 4
sse <- sum(residuals(fit)^2); sse

#Question 5
round(summary(fit)$r.squared, 2)

#Question 6
round(summary(fit)$sigma, 0)
                                            
```
